reviews.review_description: Top notch customer care. Second to none. Would absolutely recommend. Installation went smoothly. Tidy Job. Finished earlier than anticipated. Professional all the way through.

The whole experience with Ultra Greensun was excellent.  Roland was very helpful and efficient.  The installation from the first call to completion was undertaken with efficiency, friendliness and professionalism.  I absolutely recommend Ultra Green Sun Solar.
Roland sorted everything for us, including all council approval and connections.

I was recommended by a friend to use UGSST as a reliable, experienced, affordable and quality solar installer.I am glad that I took their recommendation.The whole experience was professional from the first contact with Roland through to the timely completion of the installation by the electricians.Everything was fully explained from the options available to the operation of the inverter at completion.The outstanding experience of the whole project was the fact that if they said they were going to be or do something at a certain time or date then that is exactly what occurred, no delays or excuses. All communications were excellent.I can't recommend Ultra Greensun Solar highly enough.Exceptional.

Roland and his team were great to deal with!As a female who did not know much about solar panels, Roland explained everything in a way that I could understand. He was more than happy to answer any questions I had and made me feel heard and understood. I cannot recommend Roland and the team at Ultra Green more highly!!

From my initial enquiry to the completion of the installation and beyond, Roland made the entire process of purchasing affordable, high-quality solar panels for our small property a breeze. The experience was stress-free, pressure-free, and incredibly well-supported.In the past, I had always been deterred by high-pressure sales tactics, exorbitant quotes, and a lack of information about the product. Roland, however, changed all that. He guided us through the process with ease, ensuring we were well-informed and comfortable at every step. His commitment didn't end with the installation; he even stopped by afterwards to help us understand how the unit worked.Thanks to Roland and his professional installation team, we now have a reliable solar system and the confidence that we made the right choice.
Quick responses to queries, and was able to deliver us a system that meets our needs.
Communication was always prompt and reliable. Information provided was excellent. A very streamlined and efficient service from start to finish.

Roland went over everything with me on the phone, was very quick with coming back to my questions by email, install went well on the day system turned on when I got home and was already reporting to my engey company. Only thing I found was trying to get the inverter to connect to my wifi but after a few tries I got it working. Would highly recommend this company.

This is the second time I’ve used this company and did not hesitate to contact Roland once I decided to get a solar system at my new house.  Roland was prompt and efficient in supplying information and a quote. He kept me updated on the process, gave me advice on the Tasmanian Government’s No Interest Loan Scheme and at no time did I feel pressured to make a decision in a hurry.The installers turned up on time and they were polite and efficient; the installation was completed in a day and all paperwork was sent to the appropriate authorities for final inspection.I have recommended Ultra Greensun to family and friends.

This was the second solar system that we have bought from Ultra Greensun Southern Tas. We bought this because we moved and downsized. Roland is a very professional and knowledgeable person.  His reply to my initial enquiry was prompt and followed up with a site visit. Nothing was too much trouble for him and his suggestions in regard to system size and position were spot on. We are at SaltWater river 90 minutes from Hobart, the travel time was not an issue to either Roland or his installers.Levi and his crew of installers kept me informed on the install date and arrived on time. They were very professional and polite. The job was done quickly including a switchboard upgrade, they suggested a timer on the hot water system so that it was off when not in use at night, we went with this and it works well, we have plenty of hot water for our showers in the morning. They even cleaned up after themselves and took their rubbish with them.We are very pleased with the whole process and would not hesitate to recommend Ultra Greensun Southern Tas to anyone that wants a first class system and seamless installation.
Responsive, reasonable and rapid. Roland was great to deal with.

We opted for a 10kw system . Roland organised the permits, the TAS govt loan and everything that was needed without any fuss. The sales process was seamless and the installation was done efficiently in about half a day with great communication from the installers. Really happy with the whole process and very happy with the finished product. It's absolutely pumping out power.  We'll barely have a bill for most of the year.

After quite a bit of research and conversations with installers I felt I was reasonably well informed. Roland was more than helpful and suggested I go up in kW capacity to 7.88, which we did. I opted for the 8.2 Fronius inverter so I could easily drop a few extra panels on in the future.The quote, 1 of 6 and of varying quality components, was very competitive, cheaper in fact than several smaller systems with cheaper inverters.From day one, Roland kept us informed. Checked  everything was ok for the installers and made sure it was all going where I wanted it.The weather for the install was pretty miserable but those guys got into it and got the job done pretty quickly and without fuss.All together a good experience.I highly recommend Roland and Ultra Green Sun Solar!

We had initially been recommended by friends to use Roland at Ultra Greensun Solar Southern Tas and they were right !Roland explained the process and timelines clearly for us and was happy to change the original proposed panel layout to better fit on our roof and reduce shading issues from nearby trees. We did experience some minor delays getting Aurora to our site, but here again Roland was great and helped speed the process up. Installation crew were also friendly / helpful and pleasure to have them onsite. Would highly recommend !

I just wanted to say what a pleasure it was to deal with Roland and Ultra Greensun Roland made me feel at ease from the beginning.He answered all my questions and gave me extra advice.He always rang me back within minutes and keep me in the loop.The installation was professional and the guys on site were great.I can not recommend this company more highly.Thank you.

Our 9 year old 5kw install was due for an upgrade and after obtaining 3 quotes we signed up with Ultra Greensun Solar. Roland did a comprehensive on site inspection with excellent advice on options and his quote was the most detailed, listed top quality components and was the best value. Our decision to convert to 3 ph supply delayed the install due to Tasnetworks timeframes with Roland's following up always friendly and prompt.Our north facing 30 degree pitch hall roof was ideal to get the best from a high quality system and the whole team, Roland and installer Jonathon's crew did a top job in realising that potential.

It was a pleasure to consult with Roland for a Solar system for our house. He called in and clearly went through everything that was required to greatly reduce our hydro bills.The upfront costs will be recovered quickly over time - when you see the constant rise of Gas and hydro costs.The seamless installation by his crew was excellent. All set up solar system with online monitoring of usage and electricity production. We can easily control when the hot water cylinder is using off peak power with my phone.The savings have been immediate and exceptional.Next thing will be a battery and a new electric car to go with the solar power.We highly recommend Ultra Greensun.

After receiving quotes from a number of different local solar companies, I chose Roland from Ultra Greensun Solar Southern Tasmania as my supplier.  I did this for a couple of reasons.  First, I found Roland to be a warm, helpful and most importantly in this industry, honest person, who's company has a virtually flawless reputation in the market place, and the review sites I searched.Secondly, he was open to products I preferred, namely REC Pure Alpha solar panels and the latest Sungrow 3 string inverter.  Moreover, his prices on these products was better than anyone else, but even if it was slightly more, he gave me the confidence to believe he knew what he was doing and that he would stand behind his workmanship.  With REC, for me to get their extended warranty, it required his installers to become approved by REC through a training programme.  Roland did this at his expense, without hesitation.  This alone was enormous comfort to me.Finally, he guided me through the complex process of setting up my home for solar, getting me online with the Sungrow app so I could monitor my solar consumption in real time, and going above and beyond in every aspect of my dealings with him.Two last bonuses; a) he was a registered Brighte Energy Finance supplier, which allowed us to pay for our system over a 3 year period (Tasmanian Government Incentive) interest free, and b) the resulting savings from this 6.3kw system has, for the past two months since it was installed (March/April 2023) has delivered us a credit, not a bill (albeit we have a concession card which delivers around $40/month savings, but even without that we would have had bills or around $30/month instead of the previous $120/month.  And power bills are reportedly on the rise!).Roland, and Ultragreensun Solar Southern Tasmania get my highest recommendation and I would, without hesitation recommend him and his company to anyone considering a solar system. It's been the best decision for us.

Roland was more than happy to answer my never ending list of questions without it being an issue, very prompt in replying, always keeping us up to date with the process from the start of the quote to installation. Highly recommend Roland and his company for their products, knowledge and customer service.

Fantastic all round, great information from Roland and I asked a lot of questions. The service was without fault. The panels were installed quickly and the men were great. I’m so excited to see how much power they can produce.

The most drawn out installation I’ve ever experienced. Paid in November and now it’s March and I’m still waiting to be hooked up properly. If I had my time again I would have gone with someone else.I can’t rate system because it’s still not working

We have used Ultra Greensun Solar Southern Tasmania twice since moving to Tasmania 7 years ago,we enjoyed great solar from their install at our first home and now we have downsized Ultra Greensun Solar were our first stop for our new solar and they delivered, Roland provided a competitive quote with comprehensive information re current solar etc. The installers were excellent, polite, on time and just got on with their work, 4 hours later the install was completed. Could not recommend more highly.

Roland was really informative and always delivered quotes and information when promised. Very happy to recommend to anyone looking to install solar in Hobart. The installation team were super efficient and clearly knew their stuff. They were punctual and responded quickly and efficiently to a minor adjustment that was required a day after install. Left the property tidy, hardly knew they had been here at all. Great team.

Roland was exceptional throughout the whole process. He came out to see me and answered all my questions without feeling pressured. He has kept me informed and even took time out to answer some further queries after the install. He ensured I got the extended warranty on the inverter. Roland has gone above and beyond and I cannot recommend anyone higher.
Local owner was efficient and installers professional with follow-up by owner.

Roland was quick to respond, honest in his discussions, and efficient in organising subcontractor to install. The subcontractor was prompt and efficient and pushed on to complete the job in difficult windy conditions. This did mean that there was a fair bit of wind blown litter in our yard but it kinda wasnâ€™t their fault! Techsafe check has highlighted a minor issue with the connection which should be easy to resolve and the system appears to be working great, delivering consistently good 4.9-5kW maxima (Goodwe 5kw inverter with 6.6kW of Jinko panels) on most days since installation, with surprisingly good outputs even in a run of recent cloudy days. Overall, Iâ€™m very happy! Canâ€™t wait for battery prices to come down and make them worthwhile to install.

I opted for Ultra Greensun Solar Southern Tasmania.  I had purchased an evacuated tube Solar Hot Water system from them some years previously and am very pleased with that.I have found Roland Barwin ( Managing Director of Ultra Greensun Solar Southern Tasmania) to be punctual, polite and knowledgable. Any query where he was unsure of the answer was researched and answered promptly.  Any delays or problems with delivery etc., I was notified and kept informed.

Local supplier, came to the house and run through everything with me. Installation was excellent, set up my system for online monitoring of usage and production via the enphase micro inverters.Production so far has been amazing, so looking forward to the savings this quarter.Would highly recommend this company in Tasmania.

Overall, very happy with the service from Ultra Greensun and the new system is performing really well - very exciting! The EnPhase monitoring device Envoy-S was initially not quite set up as well as we would have liked, but we worked it through with the installer and it is now set up well.  Roland was very good at listening as well as explaining. We had a good idea of the sort of features we wanted from the system and Roland took all that on board, proffered relevant and worthwhile advice and gave us confidence he was tailoring the proposed system to meet our needs. We liked the Jinko insurance cover which covers failures in the modules even if Jinko goes bust. Now considering a few (1-2 kWh) batteries to get that time shift happening... You can see how it is going on pvoutput.org (search for 'Lumina 2') or on the EnPhase public systems at https://enlighten.enphaseenergy.com/pv/public_systems/XVx8862722/overview

Initially, I contracted with Ultra Greensun for installation of a 3.5kw solar power system. I was so impressed with how smoothly and trouble-free the installation was that I decided to also to use them to install a solar hot water systeml. In both instances the advice, the standard of work and the service was outstanding.

I had been referred to Ultra Greensun by a close personal friend, who at the time was acting as an installer. This was about 4 years ago. I contacted Roland (sales Hobart) and I found him to be thorough, fair, customer focused and customer driven. He was a no B.S. salesman.To me that is a rare commodity in this day and age. I contracted him to provide a 10Kw grid connected system. This was provided and up and running very expediently.At the time I understand is was the biggest residential system in the state. Since then Ultra GreenSolar have provided me with another 5kw grid connect system and 3 Hot water systems and all are   running flawlessly.I cannot recommend Roland and his team of installers highly enough as all installations were what I would call "show room quality". No detail (no matter how small) was overlooked. After sales service was also faultless.Bearing the above comments in mind I can state that I have no ties (other than as a very satisfied customer) and would welcome any queries from prospective clients of Ultra GreenSun.Barry Hinsonbhinson@bigpond.net.au

This company had someone come to the house to asses the roof and pitch. When the installers came to the house some changes were made however I was given all the information and some advice and then allowed to make my decision. The installers were very well mannered and did a great job of cleaning up afterwards. There were some challenges on the installation due to roof pitch and things in the way but the guys made it work and all within the legal requirements. Thanks for a great job.

I chose ULTRA GREEN SUN both for the solar power & also for the solar hot water as I thought that the two should be installed to maximize the reduction in my power bill. Roland Barwon of Ultra Green Sun was the first to ring me & did a good job of explaining all about solar power, he also supplied me with 2 references who I contacted & were both happy with the product & installers. I must say that I am also impressed with both.

It took six weeks for the SMA inverter promised in the quote to arrive.This is not the fault of Ultra Greensun Solar. I believe this is due to the fact that large companies are treated better by their suppliers than small companies.The large (mainly mainland) solar companies, may provide a better price, but do not provide better service, as they were not even prepared to send someone to look at the site.In our case we had 26 panels installed over three roof surfaces.  Most larger companies were only interested in simple (one roof surface) profitable jobs.Ultra Greensun sent both the salesman and the installer in two separate visits and did a great job once all parts had arrived.
Roland from Ultra Green gave good service and was quick to respond to any enquiries.

The installer was a little untidy - leaving cable tie ends and scraps of material on the roof and ground. The orange AC supply cable from inverter to switchboard was left uncovered in a highly visible location. This was promptly rectified by rerunning in grey conduit on request.

We decided on a 3.2 kW system with an inverter rated at 5 kW to enable us to expand at a future date if necessary.The reason we chose Ultra Greensun was his prompt service in arranging the quote and explaining the pros and cons of different systems without being a "pushy" salesman. Also, he is a local Tasmanian and lives within a few kilometres of us.Of the other 2 who quoted, I had a phone call from one of them and the other just provided the quote hand written on a business card, and both of them were well after Ultra Greensun had been to see us and provided the quote.

This provider visited my house and explained person to person my requirements as well as any future needs. I was impressed with Roland as a professional  I also purchased the companies solar hot water system.The Solar system was installed within 3 days of me signing the acceptance.Great Service.
The new meter was installed on Thursday 17/01/13 and in four days, some with a lot of cloud, the meter reads power imported from Aurora 24 kWhpower exported to Aurora 62 kWh.

I needed to ask a number of questions about the panels, inverter and installers, which were all answered satisfactorily.   It would have been great if this information was provided with the quotation so I didn't need to chase it up.

Still waiting to hear from installer, was told they would contact us in 1-2 weeks with installation in about 4. It's now been 5 weeks and still no contact. Have contacted Utra Green Sun who have said they will contact installer and get them to contact us early this week, but we are still waiting.
We had the evaporated tube hot water system installed. The sales person Roland was very informative and helpful. The system is fantastic would recommend this system to anyone.
Unable to rate system as only installed 3 days ago.  Ultra Green are a Tasmanian company and I chose to support local business.
The electrician that Roland sent was fabulous.  He got all 16 panels on the front of the house so I didn't need framework and so $500 was deducted from the original price.
Vale for money and quality only rate 4 because we are unsure at this time. It's only been connected for 14 days.
The information Solarquotes provided was really helpful, thank you.

After my installation there have been 4 follow on installations ordered and are in the process.5 Days after commissioning at the "worst" time of year for solar have so far averaged production of 25% of total power requirements.would like to see the government extend the program for everyone.
